title: Not for me....
text:
Not for me..... I was not expecting much, but for me, these bags are a joke. I can't believe so many are still available, but impossible to find out who actually makes them. I wanted to make a small serving of frozen fries. I tried 6-7 different setting, different times, different fries.... It cooks them, sort-of, but not crispy, not even close.
I actually spent another $15.00 to buy a plastic rack and the original instruction book from Ebay (dumb, I know). I followed all the instructions 'exactly' but got mush potatoes over and over. I just wanted to find an alternative to the frozen Ore-Ida french fries in the microwave box. That box has the same silver top and bottom and does a perfect job every time. I even took the fries out of the box that works to try in the bag, but that didn't help. The only issue I have with the Ore-Ida fries is the price has gone from $0.90 to $1.49 in just the past 18 months. However, after investing in the microHearth (another $35.00 joke) and these silly bags, rack and cook book, the $1.49 sound really reasonable......LOL The bags might work for pizza or other things, just not french fries.
